title: UPPSC Assistant Professor Answer Key 2026: Out for 1253 Posts Now
intro: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has Officially Released Answer Key for the Post of Assistant Professor in Government Degree College Recruitment 2025 for 1253 Post. Exam Held On May 31, 2026 & Admit Card Released On May 21, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Answer Key Now in The Given Link Below.

Must have NET / SLET / SET qualification conducted by UGC/CSIR (or equivalent).
Exemptions: Candidates with Ph.D. degree (as per UGC norms) are exempted from NET/SLET/SET.
Relaxation of 5% marks for SC/ST/OBC/PH categories.

NET/SLET/SET required (unless exempted with Ph.D.).

B. Grade artist of AIR/Doordarshan OR
Strong practical knowledge with ability to explain subject.
Hindi → Language Science
Sanskrit → Language Science, Ancient History, Culture
Education → Master of Education (M.Ed.)
Commerce → Business Administration, Finance, Accountancy
Zoology → Microbiology, Human Genetics, Fisheries, Life Sciences
Botany → Plant Science, Biotechnology, Genetics, Environmental Science
Territorial Army service (min. 2 years) OR
NCC "B" Certificate OR
Proficiency in debates, seminars, sports, cultural & co-curricular activities.
They must have completed 21 years of age and should not have attained the age of 40.
The candidate must not have been born before 02 July 1985 and not after 01 July 2004.
Relaxation in the maximum age limit will be provided to reserved categories and other eligible groups as per rules (details will be available in the detailed advertisement).
Pay Scale:  Rs. 57700-182400/-, Grade Pay 6000/-, level - 10.
Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Examination (75% weightage in final selection) & Personal Interview (25% weightage)
